Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.audioplayer

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.audioplayer
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps
     
  • Class
    Description
    AlbumCoverFlow
    A Swing "cover-flow" carousel of album sleeves - the 2D counterpart of the 3D CDViewer carousel, so the music library can be browsed by album cover in both desktops (the 2D/Swing desktop has no Java 3D).
    AlbumIndex
    Groups a flat MediaItem library into albums so both cover carousels (the 3D CDViewer and the Swing AlbumCoverFlow) can present one sleeve per album.
    AlbumIndex.Album
    One album: its identity, cover path and ordered tracks.
    AudioBackend
    The AWT-free audio playback seam.
    AudioCdDb
    The AWT-free audio CD database seam: it resolves a disc ID (see MusicBrainzDiscId) to album / artist / track metadata through the free MusicBrainz web service and fetches the album cover from the free Cover Art Archive - both key-less, using only the JDK's HttpClient (the same stance as org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.weather.OpenMeteo).
    AudioCdDb.Release
    A resolved release: its MBID, album artist, title and track list.
    AudioCdDb.TrackInfo
    One track's metadata as returned by the database.
    AudioPlayer
    The audio player application: the AudioPlayerPanel Swing UI presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
    AudioPlayerClient
    Standalone JFrame wrapper for the audio player panel, for running it outside the desktop (java org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.audioplayer.AudioPlayerClient).
    AudioPlayerPanel
    The audio player's user interface: a library / playlist on the left, a now-playing display with transport controls in the centre, and a status strip along the bottom.
    AudioPlayerStore
    JSON persistence for the audio player's library and preferences.
    CdRipBackend
    The AWT-free CD-ripping seam.
    CdRipBackend.Format
    The output container / codec a rip targets.
    CdRipPanel
    The Audio Player's "Rip CD" tab: it reads the disc's table of contents, looks the album up in the CD database (MusicBrainz) to prefill artist / album / track names and fetch the cover art, then rips the selected tracks to MP3 or WAV at a chosen sampling rate.
    MediaItem
    One entry of the audio player's library / playlist: a local file, a network stream, an AM/FM or internet radio station, or a podcast episode.
    MediaItem.Kind
    What an entry points at.
    MusicBrainzDiscId
    Computes a MusicBrainz disc ID from a Toc.
    PlayerSettings
    The audio player's persisted preferences: master volume, an optional preferred external player (blank means auto-detect), and the repeat / shuffle toggles.
    Playlist
    The audio player's ordered library and playback cursor: an AWT-free model of "what plays next".
    RipSettings
    The audio player's persisted CD-ripping preferences: the output format (MP3 or WAV), the target sampling rate, the MP3 bitrate, the destination folder, the CD device, and optional preferred ripper / encoder executables (blank means auto-detect on the PATH).
    Toc
    An audio CD's table of contents: the first track number and the ordered list of audio tracks, each described by its start and length in CD frames (sectors, 1/75 s).
    Toc.Track
    One audio track: its number and its start / length in CD frames.
    TocParser
    Turns the raw text output of a CD TOC reader into a Toc.
